newsitem.title: USA: Pimco Advisors to maintain partner status.
newsitem.headline: Pimco Advisors to maintain partner status.

text.p: Pimco Advisors LP Tuesday announced its intention to continue as a publicly traded partnership rather than converting into a taxable corporation in 1998.
By extending its status as a partnership, PIMCO will be subject to lower federal taxes on its gross income than if it had converted to corporate status, it said in a statement.
Pimco Advisors is a leading investment management organization with more than $119 billion in assets under management.
